Anika (Product): Hey team — quick follow-up from the all-hands pricing slide: how do free credits expire and stack with usage-based billing? Asking for roadmap comms.
Maya (CEO): Great q. Free credits expire after 90 days by default and do not roll over. If you move to paid billing, remaining credits are applied first. We'll update the public FAQ.
Anika (Product): Thanks! Is that per-org or per-user?
Eli (Finance): Per-organization balance. If you have multiple projects under one org, credits are shared.
Sam (Eng): To add on rate limits: we enforce per-project token rate limits by default. The header you see is `X-RateLimit-Limit` and it's soft until you hit quota. We can bump it for Dedicated customers.
Anika (Product): Soft vs hard — can you clarify?
Sam (Eng): Soft == 429s are rare; we queue/shape until burst policy threshold. Hard == immediate 429s when quota exceeded.
Priya (Support): Filed a follow-up doc for all-hands Q&A: https://redwood.internal/all-hands/credits-rate-limits — will add examples.
Maya (CEO): Also note enterprise contracts can request custom rate limits and SLA. Sales will surface that.
Anika (Product): Cool. One more: do credits apply to embeddings as well?
Eli (Finance): Yes. Credits cover all metered usage (generation+embeddings+embeds). We tag costs at token/type level in billing UI.
Sam (Eng): For on-prem/private, rate limiting is configurable by admins — no global tokens from us.
Priya (Support): I'll reply to the customers who asked during the Q&A thread.
